svg.title: Good answers and average score by phone size
svg.text: Good answers and average score, by phone size.
Blind AI graders, two rounds, 160 new questions. Filled: good answers (7+ of 10). Outlined: average score, as a share of the reference answers'.
Sets 37, 46, 49, 51 (19-23 Oct), before the 4B read notes for facts; the 2B's last three sets graded a day later. Data in docs/fieldtest.
